reasoning: Dark brown-black dry necrosis confined to the blossom/tip ends of green banana fingers, with shriveled mummified tissue resembling a burnt cigar tip. This is the classic symptom of Cigar End Rot, which progresses from the flower remnants at the fruit tip inward. The rest of the fruit remains green and intact, ruling out Panama Disease (systemic) or Sigatoka/Cordana (leaf diseases).
